name: bld3_card_centralizer_of_card_prime_cube
statement: (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (G : Type*) [Group G] (hG : Nat.card G = p ^ 3) (hna : ∃ a b : G, a * b ≠ b * a) (g : G) (hg : g ∉ Subgroup.center G) : Nat.card (Subgroup.centralizer ({g} : Set G)) = p ^ 2
closed: ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (G : Type*) [Group G] (hG : Nat.card G = p ^ 3) (hna : ∃ a b : G, a * b ≠ b * a) (g : G) (hg : g ∉ Subgroup.center G), Nat.card (Subgroup.centralizer ({g} : Set G)) = p ^ 2
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld_center_card_of_card_prime_cube: the centralizer strictly contains the centre (order p, and it contains g) and is a proper subgroup (g not central), so by Lagrange its order is p^2.
type: ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → ∀ (G : Type u_1) [inst : Group G], Nat.card G = p ^ 3 → (∃ a b, a * b ≠ b * a) → ∀ g ∉ Subgroup.center G, Nat.card ↥(Subgroup.centralizer {g}) = p ^ 2
